description: Election Commission - Parliamentary Election Act No 01 of 1981 Notice under Sections 24 (I) (a) and (c) and Section 33
categorisation: This gazette content announces the scheduling of parliamentary elections, specifies polling dates and times for all electoral districts, and provides the official notice under the Parliamentary Elections Act. This directly fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it covers election announcements, schedules, and electoral district information without involving government personnel changes or structural modifications.
